<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Delimitation standoff:</strong> The Union government has signaled an upcoming Parliament session following the Congress party&#x27;s decision to boycott discussions regarding the delimitation process.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Aviation oversight:</strong> Major carriers Air India and IndiGo, alongside the Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau (AAIB), are scheduled to appear before a parliamentary panel on November 2 to address operational concerns.</li>
</ul>
